note: ADR 1130: an effect compute named by its binding and also called by name in an action step an apply runs: the store read runs untracked at the call (Chrome warns STRICT_READ_UNTRACKED) and the summaries carry it to no row there, so the tracked-position silence (`discover_member.named-at-tracked-position`) left it clean on main. The compute alone stays clean; the body call keeps its violation.
